# Habit Dots - PRD

## Goal
A tiny web app where one person ticks off daily habits on their phone and sees a streak.

## Capabilities (v1)
1. Add, rename and archive a habit.
2. Tick a habit done for today; untick it.
3. See the current streak per habit.

## Non-goals (v1)
Accounts for other people, reminders, native apps.

## Success criteria
Ticking a habit on a phone takes one tap and survives a reload.

## Stack and constraints
Python FastAPI backend with SQLite, React + Vite frontend. Runs on the owner's VPS.

## Human-only steps
Domain name and VPS access.
